description.value: Blenz Coffee is a British Columbia-born specialty coffee chain with dozens of locations across Western Canada. This Richmond location at the Garden City and Blundell Road intersection serves a broad menu of espresso drinks, whole-leaf teas, nitro beverages, and a range of food from breakfast wraps and sandwiches to baked goods and desserts. Touring cyclists looking for a quick refuel stop in south Richmond will find full café service and takeout ordering available.
